• 12 Olympiads: Maths (iOM), Science (iOS), English (iOEL), STEM, Computer (iCSO), Talent Hunt (iTHO), Hindi (ABHO), Social Studies (iSSO), Reasoning (iRAO), GK (SKGKO), Commerce (iSCO) & AI (iAIO)

• All Level 3 winners win an educational visit to ISRO & international study tours (NASA/UK)
• No additional fee for Level 2 & Level 3
• School retention allowance included for teacher in-charge honorarium & exam administration
• RealMetrics™ comprehensive student benchmarking report for your school management
